title: PDEA seizes P81.6 million worth of shabu in Batangas Port; 4 arrested
summary: Four individuals were arrested by the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) after around 12 kilograms of suspected shabu were seized from their vehicle at the Batangas Port on Wednesday.
